show.description: Once a champion racer, Aryan Verma loses everything after betrayal by his adopted brother Kabir, who rigs a race, kills their parents, and takes his crown. Broken and forgotten, Aryan returns in disguise as Monty, a humble mechanic. When a struggling racing club puts its last hope on him, Monty must face his past, defeat Kabir, and reclaim his destiny on the track.
